description:
Library functions that only tests call, or that forward to another library function unchanged, are removed, and their tests call the real entry point.

## Background

A read-only survey (2026-11-04) found production functions whose only callers are tests: `query_by_state`, `query_by_priority`, `query_by_label` and `query_by_labels` in `crates/jit/src/commands/query.rs` (the domain queries they wrap are called directly elsewhere); `tail_events` in `commands/events.rs`, which equals `query_events(None, None, n)`; `is_outermost` in `storage/repo_lock.rs`; `get_issue` in `commands/labels.rs`; `deserialize_virtual_path` in `repository_state/path.rs`; and the non-policy `add_dependency` / `add_dependency_with_policy` / `add_dependencies` wrappers in `commands/dependency.rs`, where `add_dependencies_with_policy` is the entry point production uses.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: None of the functions named in the Background exists, and `cargo build` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` pass with zero warnings.
- [hard] REQ-02: The `jit events tail` handler reads through `query_events`, with unchanged output.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every test that called a removed function calls the production entry point instead and asserts the same property, with no assertion weakened and no test deleted without its property moving to another owning test.
- [hard] REQ-04: No command's JSON payload, human output or exit code changes.
- [hard] REQ-05: The crate's production lines (`scripts/production-lines.py`, default mode) fall by at least 50.

## Notes

Part of the epic's net-reduction work (plan D-51, D-53).
title: Remove library functions only tests call
